actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is poisoned. At the end of its next turn  it repeats the saving throw. On a success  the effect ends. On a failure  it falls unconscious for 1 minute. If it takes damage or a creature uses an action to shake it awake  it wakes up  and the poisoned effect ends.
